(to_jsonb(NEW)-'batch_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'batch_id') AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n   JOIN public.public_archive_batches b ON b.batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND s.new_batch_id=NEW.batch_id\n    AND a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id AND a.consumed_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND b.state='claimed' AND b.prior_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n    AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE e.event_id=NEW.event_id\n      AND e.canonical_event=NEW.canonical_event)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  IF NEW.canonical_event=''::bytea AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'canonical_event')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'canonical_event') AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batches b JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id)\n   WHERE b.batch_id=NEW.batch_id AND b.state='acked' AND b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable pending membership';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n  IF OLD.state IN ('acked','superseded') AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal archive state immutable'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.state='superseded' AND OLD.state<>'superseded' AND NOT EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n    AND a.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.eligible_until<=lifecycle_private.archive_clock()) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit consumed archive replacement authorization required'; END IF;\n  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation'])\n    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation']) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable batch membership and seal clock'; END IF;\n  IF OLD.state<>'claimed' AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','acked_at','owner_token','generation'])\n    IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','acked_at','owner_token','generation']) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable persisted seal'; END IF;\n  IF OLD.state='acked' AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD OR OLD.state='sealed' AND NEW.state='claimed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive state cannot move backward'; END IF;\n  RETURN NEW;\n END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('public_outbox','public_change_requirements') THEN\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_outbox' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c\n    JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id) WHERE c.event_id::text=to_jsonb(OLD)->>'event_id') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_change_requirements' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_outbox WHERE requirement_id=(to_jsonb(OLD)->>'id')::bigint)\n   AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id)\n     WHERE c.aggregate_type=OLD.aggregate_type AND c.aggregate_id=OLD.aggregate_id AND c.revision=OLD.revision) THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n END IF;\n RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable pending event or archive history';\nEND $function$\n", 'proconfig': ['search_path=pg_catalog'], 'prosecdef': False, 'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}', 'owner': 'postgres'}, {'nspname': 'lifecycle_private', 'proname': IF;\n IF NEW.slot<>OLD.slot THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational slot identity immutable'; END IF;\n IF OLD.state='free' AND NEW.state='allocated' THEN\n  IF NOT lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical slot requires operational receipt'; END IF;\n ELSIF OLD.state='allocated' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN\n  IF NOT lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) OR NEW.transaction_id<>pg_current_xact_id()\n   OR (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','event_id','predecessor_id','canonical_event','padding']) IS DISTINCT FROM\n      (to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','event_id','predecessor_id','canonical_event','padding']) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical event differs from allocated public change'; END IF;\n ELSIF OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state='acked' THEN\n  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'state') OR NOT EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id) WHERE c.event_id=OLD.event_id) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical slot ack requires exact durable receipt'; END IF;\n ELSIF OLD.state='acked' AND NEW.state='acked' AND NEW.body='{}'::jsonb AND NEW.canonical_event=''::bytea\n  AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['body','canonical_event'])=(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['body','canonical_event']) THEN\n  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN public.public_archive_batch_markers b USING(batch_id) WHERE c.event_id=OLD.event_id\n    AND b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical terminal retention not reached'; END IF;\n ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending critical event is immutable; slots never recycled automatically'; END IF;\n IF NEW.state='pending' THEN\n  envelope:=convert_from(NEW.canonical_event,'UTF8')::jsonb;\n  IF envelope->>'event_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_id::text OR envelope->'body' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.body\n    OR (envelope->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.observed_at OR (envelope->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.recorded_at OR envelope->>'provenance' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.provenance OR envelope->>'aggregate_type' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_type OR envelope->>'aggregate_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_id\n    OR (envelope->>'revision')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.revision OR envelope->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.kind\n    OR envelope->>'predecessor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.predecessor_id::text OR (envelope->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.occurred_at THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical event envelope differs from exact projection'; END IF;\n  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type\n    AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision-1)\n    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage e WHERE e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type\n    AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision-1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical predecessor unavailable'; END IF;\n  SELECT count(*),lifecycle_private.archive_budget_bytes() INTO total_count,total_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n  IF total_count+1>100000 OR total_bytes+2*octet_length(NEW.canonical_event)+lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(NEW.canonical_event)>134217728 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical outbox budget 'definition': "CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.require_public_change()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nDECLARE ctl ('job_locations','job_skills') AND\n  lifecycle_private.edge_compaction_ready(TG_TABLE_NAME,(o->>'id')::uuid,(o->>'job_version_id')::uuid)\n  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.source_listings WHERE TG_TABLE_NAME='locations' THEN 'raw' ELSE 'id' END;\n SELECT source_id INTO sid FROM public.lifecycle_operational_receipts WHERE backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()\n  AND transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id() AND lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(source_id) LIMIT 1;\n IF sid IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_heads WHERE aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME AND aggregate_id=aid) THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational archive baseline not ready'; END IF;\n IF sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n  UPDATE public.public_archive_heads SET revision=revision+1 WHERE aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME AND aggregate_id=aid RETURNING revision INTO rev;\n ELSE\n INSERT INTO public.public_archive_heads VALUES(TG_TABLE_NAME,aid,1)\n ON CONFLICT(aggregate_type,aggregate_id) DO UPDATE SET revision=public.public_archive_heads.revision+1 RETURNING revision INTO rev;\n END IF;\n k:=CASE WHEN rev=1 THEN 'baseline' WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN 'removed'\n  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND n->>'closed_at' IS NOT NULL AND o->>'closed_at' IS NULL THEN 'closed'\n  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND n->>'closed_at' IS NULL AND t='source_listings' THEN sid:=(n->>'source_account_id')::uuid;\n  fields:=ARRAY['source_availability','successful_last_observed_at','successful_sighting_count','consecutive_complete_misses','first_complete_miss_at'];\n ELSIF t='jobs' THEN\n  SELECT l.source_account_id INTO sid FROM public.source_listings l JOIN public.lifecycle_operational_listings p ON p.listing_id=l.id\n    WHERE l.job_id=n->>'id' AND lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(l.source_account_id) LIMIT 1;\n  fields:=ARRAY['closed_at'];\n ELSE RETURN false;\n END IF;\n IF sid IS NULL OR NOT lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(sid) THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n IF t='source_accounts' AND n->>'last_outcome' NOT IN ('attempting','complete','partial','failed','suspicious_empty') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid bounded source outcome'; END IF;\n IF n-fields IS DISTINCT FROM o-fields THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational update exceeds fixed field allowlist'; END IF;\n IF t='source_listings' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.lifecycle_operational_listings WHERE listing_id=(n->>'id')::uuid) THEN\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational listing not preallocated'; END IF;\n UPDATE lifecycle_private.preserve_archive_row()\n RETURNS trigger\n LANGUAGE plpgsql\n SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\nAS $function$\nBEGIN\n IF TG_OP='TRUNCATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive pending/history cannot be truncated'; END IF;\n IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('public_archive_items','public_archive_receipts','public_archive_batches') AND EXISTS(\n  SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batch_markers m WHERE m.batch_id=(to_jsonb(OLD)->>'batch_id')::uuid\n   AND m.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' THEN\n  IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND OLD.state='superseded' AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n   AND s.replaced_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN OLD; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_items' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'batch_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'batch_id') AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n   JOIN public.public_archive_batches b ON b.batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND s.new_batch_id=NEW.batch_id\n    AND a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id AND a.consumed_at IS NOT NULL\n    AND b.state='claimed' AND b.prior_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n    AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE e.event_id=NEW.event_id\n      AND e.canonical_event=NEW.canonical_event)) THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  IF NEW.canonical_event=''::bytea AND (to_jsonb(NEW)-'canonical_event')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'canonical_event') AND EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batches b JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id)\n   WHERE b.batch_id=NEW.batch_id AND b.state='acked' AND b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;\n  RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable pending membership';\n END IF;\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n  IF OLD.state IN ('acked','superseded') AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM OLD THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal archive state immutable'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.state='superseded' AND OLD.state<>'superseded' AND NOT EXISTS(\n   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON END IF;\n END IF;\n -- Payload fields are charged on every rewrite, including same-size replacements;\n -- a prior DELETE or shrink never supplies physical allocation credit.\n IF TG_TABLE_NAME IN ('jobs','job_questions','job_reviews','review_corrections','application_packages','resume_scores','cover_letter_edits','generation_jobs','job_payload_demands') THEN\n  -- Inspect actual declared types: JSON numeric/boolean/string scalars are\n  -- payload too. SQL numeric metadata is not confused with a JSON scalar.\n  SELECT array_agg(attname::text) INTO json_keys FROM pg_attribute\n   WHERE attrelid=TG_RELID AND attnum>0 AND NOT attisdropped\n   AND atttypid IN ('jsonb'::regtype,'json'::regtype);\n  FOR k,payload IN SELECT key,value FROM jsonb_each_text(n) LOOP\n   oldpayload:=o->>k;\n   IF payload IS NOT NULL AND payload IS DISTINCT FROM oldpayload\n     AND (k=ANY(json_keys) AND n->k NOT IN ('{}'::jsonb,'[]'::jsonb,'null'::jsonb)\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k) IN ('object','array') AND payload NOT IN ('{}','[]')\n       OR jsonb_typeof(n->k)='string' AND\n       (octet_length(payload)>256 OR (k NOT IN (\n        'id','user_id','job_id','job_version_id','profile_version','verdict','stage1_decision',\n        'experience_match','confidence','work_arrangement','pay_period','status','kind',\n        'description_capture_provenance','capture_provenance','description_version_id',\n        'claim_owner_token','lease_until','protection_until') AND k NOT LIKE '%\\_at' ESCAPE '\\')))\n   THEN growth:=growth+octet_length(payload)*4+256; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF growth>0 THEN\n  BEGIN rid:=NULLIF(current_setting('lifecycle.reservation',true),'')::uuid;\n  EXCEPTION WHEN invalid_text_representation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'growth_without_reservation'; END IF;\n IF NEW.activation_generation<OLD.activation_generation OR NEW.flags_version<OLD.flags_version THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control generation and schema version are monotonic'; END IF;\n IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'identity_migration_activated_at') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)-'identity_migration_activated_at') AND NEW.activation_generation<=OLD.activation_generation THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'control changes require a newer activation generation'; END IF;\n  IF NEW.retirement_enabled AND NOT NEW.retirement_dry_run AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'retirement requires enforced lifecycle stage'; END IF;\n END IF;\n IF OLD.safety_stage='enforced' AND NEW.safety_stage<>'enforced' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'unsafe legacy rollback after cutover'; was_paused boolean; req review_requests%ROWTYPE;\nBEGIN\n PERFORM set_config('lock_timeout','2s',true);\n PERFORM set_config('statement_timeout','5s',true);\n PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(20916294442894917);\n IF uid IS NULL OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM account_deletions WHERE user_id=uid) THEN\n   RAISE EXCEPTION 'sign in' USING ERRCODE='42501';\n END IF;\n PERFORM 1 FROM matching_activity WHERE user_id=uid FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'profile required' USING ERRCODE='42501'; Retry\n -- insertion if so; never return a synthetic pending success without durable work.\n SELECT * INTO req FROM review_requests WHERE user_id=uid AND review_requests.status IN ('pending','running') FOR UPDATE;\n IF NOT FOUND THEN\n   INSERT INTO review_requests(user_id) VALUES(uid) RETURNING * INTO req;\n   RETURN QUERY SELECT req.status,false; +                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '

+                ' RETURNS boolean\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                ' STABLE\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE t text; key text; missing boolean;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                ' FOREACH t IN ARRAY '
+                "ARRAY['jobs','source_accounts','source_listings','job_versions','companies','locations',\n"
+                '  '
+                "'brands','skills','company_brands','company_sources','job_locations','job_skills','identity_assertions'] "
+                'LOOP\n'
+                "  key:=CASE WHEN t='locations' THEN 'raw' ELSE 'id' END;\n"
+                "  EXECUTE format('SELECT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.%I t WHERE NOT "
+                'EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_heads h WHERE '
+                "h.aggregate_type=$1 AND h.aggregate_id=t.%I::text))',t,key) INTO "
+                'missing USING t;\n'
+                '  IF missing THEN RETURN false; END IF;\n'
+                ' END LOOP;\n'
+                ' RETURN true;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',
+                'proconfig': [
+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',

+                ' LANGUAGE sql\n'
+                ' STABLE\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                ' SELECT\n'
+                ' COALESCE((SELECT '
+                'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,NULL,2048)) FROM '
+                'public.public_change_requirements),0)\n'
+                ' +COALESCE((SELECT '
+                'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,canonical_event,2048)\n'
+                '   +lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(canonical_event)) '
+                'FROM public.public_outbox),0)\n'
+                ' +COALESCE((SELECT '
+                'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(body,canonical_event,2048)\n'
+                "   +CASE WHEN state='pending' THEN "
+                'lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(canonical_event) ELSE '
+                '0 END)\n'
+                '   FROM public.public_critical_event_slots WHERE state IN '
+                "('allocated','pending')),0)\n"
+                '$function$\n',

+                '  WHERE singleton AND validated_at<=clock_timestamp() AND '
+                'private_validated AND encryption_validated\n'
+                '  AND policy_validated AND length(btrim(validation_evidence))>0\n'

+                "NOT LIKE '%..%' AND bucket !~ '^[0-9.]+$'\n"
+                "  AND region ~ '^[a-z]{2}(-[a-z]+)+-[0-9]$' AND expected_owner ~ "
+                "'^[0-9]{12}$'\n"
+                '  AND length(object_prefix)<=256 AND object_prefix ~ '

+                'sum(lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(NULL,i.canonical_event,1024)) '

+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                " IF TG_OP='TRUNCATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive "
+                "pending/history cannot be truncated'; END IF;\n"
+                " IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN "
+                "('public_archive_items','public_archive_receipts','public_archive_batches') "
+                'AND EXISTS(\n'
+                '  SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batch_markers m WHERE '
+                "m.batch_id=(to_jsonb(OLD)->>'batch_id')::uuid\n"
+                "   AND m.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN "

+                '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s WHERE '
+                's.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n'
+                "   AND s.replaced_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN "
+                'RETURN OLD; END IF;\n'
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_items' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' THEN\n"
+                "  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'batch_id')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'batch_id') AND "
+                'EXISTS(\n'
+                '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n'
+                '   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON '
+                'a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n'
+                '   JOIN public.public_archive_batches b ON '
+                'b.batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n'
+                '   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND '
+                's.new_batch_id=NEW.batch_id\n'
+                '    AND a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id AND a.consumed_at '
+                'IS NOT NULL\n'
+                "    AND b.state='claimed' AND b.prior_batch_id=OLD.batch_id\n"
+                '    AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE '

+                '      AND e.canonical_event=NEW.canonical_event)) THEN RETURN '
+                'NEW; END IF;\n'

+                "(to_jsonb(NEW)-'canonical_event')=(to_jsonb(OLD)-'canonical_event') "

+                '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_batches b JOIN '
+                'public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id)\n'
+                "   WHERE b.batch_id=NEW.batch_id AND b.state='acked' AND "
+                "b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN RETURN NEW; "
+                'END IF;\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable pending membership';\n"
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_archive_batches' AND TG_OP='UPDATE' "
+                'THEN\n'
+                "  IF OLD.state IN ('acked','superseded') AND NEW IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                'OLD THEN\n'
+                "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'terminal archive state immutable'; END IF;\n"
+                "  IF NEW.state='superseded' AND OLD.state<>'superseded' AND NOT "
+                'EXISTS(\n'
+                '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_supersessions s\n'
+                '   JOIN public.public_archive_recovery_authorizations a ON '
+                'a.authorization_id=s.authorization_id\n'
+                '   WHERE s.old_batch_id=OLD.batch_id AND '
+                'a.replacement_batch_id=s.new_batch_id\n'
+                '    AND a.consumed_at IS NOT NULL AND '
+                'OLD.eligible_until<=lifecycle_private.archive_clock()) THEN\n'
+                "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'explicit consumed archive replacement "
+                "authorization required'; END IF;\n"
+                '  IF '
+                "(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation'])\n"
+                '    IS DISTINCT FROM '
+                "(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','event_ids_sha256','aggregate_revision_ranges','data_key','manifest_key','canonical_hash','compressed_hash','manifest_hash','compressed_bytes','manifest_bytes','acked_at','owner_token','generation']) "
+                'THEN\n'
+                "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable batch membership and seal clock'; "
+                'END IF;\n'
+                "  IF OLD.state<>'claimed' AND "

+                '    IS DISTINCT FROM '

+                "OLD.state='sealed' AND NEW.state='claimed' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION "
+                "'archive state cannot move backward'; END IF;\n"
+                '  RETURN NEW;\n'
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                " IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN "
+                "('public_outbox','public_change_requirements') THEN\n"
+                "  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_outbox' AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM "

+                '    JOIN public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id) WHERE '
+                "c.event_id::text=to_jsonb(OLD)->>'event_id') THEN RETURN OLD; END "
+                'IF;\n'
+                "  IF TG_TABLE_NAME='public_change_requirements' AND NOT "
+                'EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_outbox WHERE '
+                "requirement_id=(to_jsonb(OLD)->>'id')::bigint)\n"
+                '   AND EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN '
+                'public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id)\n'
+                '     WHERE c.aggregate_type=OLD.aggregate_type AND '
+                'c.aggregate_id=OLD.aggregate_id AND c.revision=OLD.revision) THEN '
+                'RETURN OLD; END IF;\n'
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                " RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable pending event or archive history';\n"
+                'END $function$\n',
+                'proconfig': [
+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'preserve_operational_slot',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.preserve_operational_slot()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE envelope jsonb; total_count bigint; total_bytes bigint;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                " IF TG_OP<>'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational slots "
+                "cannot be deleted or truncated'; END IF;\n"
+                " IF NEW.slot<>OLD.slot THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational slot "
+                "identity immutable'; END IF;\n"
+                " IF OLD.state='free' AND NEW.state='allocated' THEN\n"
+                '  IF NOT '
+                'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) THEN '
+                "RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical slot requires operational receipt'; END "
+                'IF;\n'
+                " ELSIF OLD.state='allocated' AND NEW.state='pending' THEN\n"
+                '  IF NOT '
+                'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) OR '
+                'NEW.transaction_id<>pg_current_xact_id()\n'
+                '   OR '
+                "(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['state','event_id','predecessor_id','canonical_event','padding']) "
+                'IS DISTINCT FROM\n'
+                '      '
+                "(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['state','event_id','predecessor_id','canonical_event','padding']) "
+                'THEN\n'
+                "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical event differs from allocated public "
+                "change'; END IF;\n"
+                " ELSIF OLD.state='pending' AND NEW.state='acked' THEN\n"
+                "  IF (to_jsonb(NEW)-'state') IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "(to_jsonb(OLD)-'state') OR NOT EXISTS(\n"
+                '   SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN '
+                'public.public_archive_receipts r USING(batch_id) WHERE '
+                'c.event_id=OLD.event_id) THEN\n'
+                "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical slot ack requires exact durable "
+                "receipt'; END IF;\n"
+                " ELSIF OLD.state='acked' AND NEW.state='acked' AND "
+                "NEW.body='{}'::jsonb AND NEW.canonical_event=''::bytea\n"
+                '  AND '
+                "(to_jsonb(NEW)-ARRAY['body','canonical_event'])=(to_jsonb(OLD)-ARRAY['body','canonical_event']) "
+                'THEN\n'
+                '  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage c JOIN '
+                'public.public_archive_batch_markers b USING(batch_id) WHERE '
+                'c.event_id=OLD.event_id\n'
+                "    AND b.acked_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '7 days') THEN "
+                "RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical terminal retention not reached'; END "
+                'IF;\n'
+                " ELSE RAISE EXCEPTION 'pending critical event is immutable; slots "
+                "never recycled automatically'; END IF;\n"
+                " IF NEW.state='pending' THEN\n"
+                "  envelope:=convert_from(NEW.canonical_event,'UTF8')::jsonb;\n"
+                "  IF envelope->>'event_id' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.event_id::text OR "
+                "envelope->'body' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.body\n"
+                "    OR (envelope->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "NEW.observed_at OR (envelope->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS "
+                "DISTINCT FROM NEW.recorded_at OR envelope->>'provenance' IS "
+                "DISTINCT FROM NEW.provenance OR envelope->>'aggregate_type' IS "
+                "DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_type OR envelope->>'aggregate_id' IS "
+                'DISTINCT FROM NEW.aggregate_id\n'
+                "    OR (envelope->>'revision')::bigint IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "NEW.revision OR envelope->>'kind' IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.kind\n"
+                "    OR envelope->>'predecessor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                'NEW.predecessor_id::text OR '
+                "(envelope->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                'NEW.occurred_at THEN\n'
+                "   RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical event envelope differs from exact "
+                "projection'; END IF;\n"
+                '  IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e WHERE '
+                'e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id AND '
+                'e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type\n'
+                '    AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND '
+                'e.revision=NEW.revision-1)\n'
+                '    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage e '
+                'WHERE e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id AND '
+                'e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type\n'
+                '    AND e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND '
+                "e.revision=NEW.revision-1) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical "
+                "predecessor unavailable'; END IF;\n"
+                '  SELECT count(*),lifecycle_private.archive_budget_bytes() INTO '
+                'total_count,total_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n'
+                '  IF total_count+1>100000 OR '
+                'total_bytes+2*octet_length(NEW.canonical_event)+lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(NEW.canonical_event)>134217728 '
+                "THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical outbox budget exhausted'; END IF;\n"
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',
+                'proconfig': [
+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'protect_demand_claim',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.protect_demand_claim()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                ' SECURITY DEFINER\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                " IF current_setting('role')='authenticated' AND OLD.user_id IS "
+                "DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id() THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'foreign "
+                "lifecycle owner' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;\n"
+                ' -- Deleting an owner queue row cannot silently cancel/release a '
+                'live service\n'
+                ' -- claim. The service must fence the claim first (account '
+                'erasure does so).\n'
+                ' IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.lifecycle_claims WHERE '
+                "kind='demand' AND work_id=OLD.id::text\n"
+                " AND state='active' AND generation>replay_floor) THEN\n"
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'demand removal requires fenced service claim'; "
+                'END IF;\n'
+                ' RETURN OLD;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',

+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',

+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',

+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'public_projection',
+                'arguments': 't text, n jsonb',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.public_projection(t '
+                'text, n jsonb)\n'

+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                ' IMMUTABLE\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE fields text[]; result jsonb;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                ' CASE t\n'
+                " WHEN 'jobs' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','company_id','external_id','title','url','location','department','remote','closed_at'];\n"
+                " WHEN 'source_accounts' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','legacy_company_id','ats','public_board_ref','public_url','exclusion_state'];\n"
+                " WHEN 'source_listings' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','source_account_id','external_id','job_id','current_version_id','current_revision','original_discovered_at','source_published_at','source_published_provenance','discovery_anchor_at','discovery_anchor_provenance','discovery_expires_at','source_availability','suspected_id_reuse'];\n"
+                " WHEN 'job_versions' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','job_id','source_listing_id','revision','content_hash','public_metadata','observed_at'];\n"
+                " WHEN 'companies' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','name','ats','token','display_name','industry','industry_subcategory','size','hq_country'];\n"
+                " WHEN 'locations' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['raw','canonicals','components','source'];\n"

+                " WHEN 'company_sources' THEN "

+                " WHEN 'job_locations' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','evidence_kind','public_evidence_ref','observed_at','valid_from','valid_to','status','confidence','revision','job_version_id','location_id'];\n"
+                " WHEN 'job_skills' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','evidence_kind','public_evidence_ref','observed_at','valid_from','valid_to','status','confidence','revision','job_version_id','skill_id'];\n"
+                " WHEN 'identity_assertions' THEN "
+                "fields:=ARRAY['id','evidence_kind','public_evidence_ref','observed_at','valid_from','valid_to','status','confidence','revision','left_listing_id','right_listing_id','relation','reviewed_at'];\n"
+                ' ELSE RETURN NULL;\n'
+                ' END CASE;\n'
+                ' SELECT jsonb_object_agg(key,value) INTO result FROM '
+                'jsonb_each(n) WHERE key=ANY(fields);\n'
+                ' RETURN result;\n'

+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'require_public_change',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.require_public_change()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE ctl public.lifecycle_control; n jsonb; o jsonb; aid text; '
+                'rev bigint; k text; sid uuid; slot_id integer; raw jsonb; oldraw '
+                'jsonb; observed timestamptz; provenance_value text;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                ' SELECT * INTO STRICT ctl FROM public.lifecycle_control WHERE '
+                'singleton;\n'
+                ' IF NOT ctl.archive_ever_activated THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n'
+                " n:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN NULL ELSE "
+                'lifecycle_private.public_projection(TG_TABLE_NAME,to_jsonb(NEW)) '
+                'END;\n'
+                " o:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN NULL ELSE "
+                'lifecycle_private.public_projection(TG_TABLE_NAME,to_jsonb(OLD)) '
+                'END;\n'
+                ' IF n IS NOT DISTINCT FROM o THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n'
+                ' -- Safe local version retirement does not assert disappearance '
+                'of public facts.\n'
+                " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='job_versions' AND TG_OP='DELETE' AND EXISTS(\n"
+                '  SELECT FROM public.public_archive_version_coverage c WHERE '
+                "c.version_id::text=o->>'id' AND "
+                "c.content_hash=o->>'content_hash'\n"
+                "   AND c.source_listing_id::text=o->>'source_listing_id' AND "
+                "c.version_revision=(o->>'revision')::bigint) THEN RETURN NULL; "
+                'END IF;\n'
+                ' -- Exact acknowledged local edge compaction retains the public '
+                'history/head.\n'
+                " IF TG_OP='DELETE' AND TG_TABLE_NAME IN "
+                "('job_locations','job_skills') AND\n"
+                '  '
+                "lifecycle_private.edge_compaction_ready(TG_TABLE_NAME,(o->>'id')::uuid,(o->>'job_version_id')::uuid)\n"
+                '  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.source_listings WHERE '
+                "current_version_id=(o->>'job_version_id')::uuid)\n"
+                ' THEN RETURN NULL; END IF;\n'
+                " IF ctl.archive_stage<>'active' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'archive "
+                "producer paused'; END IF;\n"
+                " aid:=COALESCE(n,o)->>CASE WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='locations' THEN "
+                "'raw' ELSE 'id' END;\n"
+                ' SELECT source_id INTO sid FROM '
+                'public.lifecycle_operational_receipts WHERE '
+                'backend_pid=pg_backend_pid()\n'
+                '  AND transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id() AND '
+                'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(source_id) LIMIT 1;\n'
+                ' IF sid IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM '
+                'public.public_archive_heads WHERE aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME '
+                'AND aggregate_id=aid) THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational archive baseline not ready'; END "
+                'IF;\n'
+                ' IF sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n'
+                '  UPDATE public.public_archive_heads SET revision=revision+1 '
+                'WHERE aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME AND aggregate_id=aid RETURNING '
+                'revision INTO rev;\n'
+                ' ELSE\n'
+                ' INSERT INTO public.public_archive_heads '
+                'VALUES(TG_TABLE_NAME,aid,1)\n'
+                ' ON CONFLICT(aggregate_type,aggregate_id) DO UPDATE SET '
+                'revision=public.public_archive_heads.revision+1 RETURNING '
+                'revision INTO rev;\n'
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                " k:=CASE WHEN rev=1 THEN 'baseline' WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN "
+                "'removed'\n"
+                "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND "
+                "n->>'closed_at' IS NOT NULL AND o->>'closed_at' IS NULL THEN "
+                "'closed'\n"
+                "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' AND n-'closed_at'=o-'closed_at' AND "
+                "n->>'closed_at' IS NULL AND o->>'closed_at' IS NOT NULL THEN "
+                "'reopened'\n"
+                "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' AND "
+                "n-'source_availability'=o-'source_availability' AND "
+                "n->>'source_availability'='closed' AND "
+                "o->>'source_availability'<>'closed' THEN 'closed'\n"
+                "  WHEN TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' AND "
+                "n-'source_availability'=o-'source_availability' AND "
+                "n->>'source_availability'='open' AND "
+                "o->>'source_availability'='closed' THEN 'reopened'\n"
+                "  ELSE 'upsert' END;\n"
+                " raw:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN to_jsonb(OLD) ELSE "
+                'to_jsonb(NEW) END;\n'
+                " oldraw:=CASE WHEN TG_OP='INSERT' THEN '{}'::jsonb ELSE "
+                'to_jsonb(OLD) END;\n'
+                " observed:=NULLIF(raw->>'observed_at','')::timestamptz;\n"
+                " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='jobs' THEN\n"
+                "  IF k='closed' THEN observed:=(raw->>'closed_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+                "  ELSIF raw->>'last_seen_at' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "oldraw->>'last_seen_at' THEN\n"
+                "   observed:=(raw->>'last_seen_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+                "  ELSIF k='reopened' THEN observed:=(SELECT "
+                'successful_last_observed_at FROM public.source_listings WHERE '
+                'job_id=aid ORDER BY successful_last_observed_at DESC NULLS LAST '
+                'LIMIT 1);\n'
+                '  END IF;\n'
+                " ELSIF TG_TABLE_NAME='source_listings' THEN\n"
+                "  IF raw->>'successful_last_observed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "oldraw->>'successful_last_observed_at' THEN\n"
+                "   observed:=(raw->>'successful_last_observed_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+                "  ELSIF raw->>'content_changed_at' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "oldraw->>'content_changed_at' THEN\n"
+                "   observed:=(raw->>'content_changed_at')::timestamptz;\n"
+                "  ELSIF k='closed' AND sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n"
+                '   observed:=(SELECT completed_at FROM '
+                'public.lifecycle_operational_sources WHERE source_id=sid);\n'
+                "  ELSIF k='closed' THEN observed:=(SELECT completed_at FROM "
+                'public.source_enumerations WHERE '
+                "id=(raw->>'last_miss_enumeration_id')::uuid);\n"
+                '  END IF;\n'
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                ' provenance_value:=CASE WHEN observed IS NOT NULL THEN '
+                "'source_observation' WHEN k='baseline' THEN 'current_baseline' "
+                "ELSE 'database_change' END;\n"
+                ' IF sid IS NOT NULL THEN\n'
+                "  IF k NOT IN ('closed','reopened') THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'only "
+                "critical closure/reopen uses operational event slots'; END IF;\n"
+                '  SELECT slot INTO slot_id FROM '
+                "public.public_critical_event_slots WHERE state='free' ORDER BY "
+                'slot LIMIT 1;\n'
+                "  IF slot_id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'critical operational "
+                "event slots exhausted'; END IF;\n"
+                '  UPDATE public.public_critical_event_slots SET '
+                "state='allocated',transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id(),source_id=sid,\n"
+                '   '
+                'aggregate_type=TG_TABLE_NAME,aggregate_id=aid,revision=rev,kind=k,body=COALESCE(n,o),occurred_at=clock_timestamp(),recorded_at=clock_timestamp(),observed_at=observed,provenance=provenance_value\n'
+                '   WHERE slot=slot_id;\n'
+                '  RETURN NULL;\n'
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                ' INSERT INTO '
+                'public.public_change_requirements(aggregate_type,aggregate_id,revision,kind,body,observed_at,provenance)\n'
+                ' '
+                'VALUES(TG_TABLE_NAME,aid,rev,k,COALESCE(n,o),observed,provenance_value);\n'
+                ' RETURN NULL;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',
+                'proconfig': [
+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'validate_archive_item',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.validate_archive_item()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE b public.public_archive_batches;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                ' SELECT * INTO STRICT b FROM public.public_archive_batches WHERE '
+                'batch_id=NEW.batch_id;\n'
+                " IF b.state<>'claimed' OR NEW.position>=b.event_count OR NOT "
+                'EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_pending_events e\n'
+                '  WHERE e.event_id=NEW.event_id AND '
+                'e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+                'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id\n'
+                '  AND e.revision=NEW.revision AND '
+                'e.canonical_event=NEW.canonical_event) THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'batch item must match exact unsealed pending "
+                "event'; END IF;\n"
+                ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',
+                'proconfig': [
+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'validate_operational_receipt',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.validate_operational_receipt()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                " IF COALESCE(current_query(),'') !~* "
+                "'^[[:space:]]*(COMMIT|END)([[:space:]]+(WORK|TRANSACTION))?[[:space:]]*;?[[:space:]]*$' "
+                'THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational receipt requires standalone "
+                "COMMIT'; END IF;\n"

+                'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(NEW.source_id) THEN '
+                "RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational receipt claim expired or fenced'; "
+                'END IF;\n'

+                "transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id() AND state='allocated') THEN\n"

+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'validate_operational_state',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.validate_operational_state()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE sid uuid;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                " IF TG_OP<>'UPDATE' THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'preallocated "
+                "operational identity cannot be deleted or truncated'; END IF;\n"
+                ' sid:=NEW.source_id;\n'
+                ' IF sid<>OLD.source_id OR NOT '
+                'lifecycle_private.operational_receipt_valid(sid) THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational update requires same-source "
+                "current receipt'; END IF;\n"
+                " IF TG_TABLE_NAME='lifecycle_operational_listings' AND "
+                "to_jsonb(NEW)->>'listing_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "to_jsonb(OLD)->>'listing_id' THEN\n"
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'operational listing identity immutable'; END "
+                'IF;\n'
+                ' UPDATE public.lifecycle_operational_receipts SET '
+                'row_count=row_count+1 WHERE source_id=sid;\n'
+                ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',

+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'validate_outbox_insert',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.validate_outbox_insert()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE r public.public_change_requirements; usage_count bigint; '
+                'usage_bytes bigint; critical boolean; envelope jsonb;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                ' SELECT * INTO r FROM public.public_change_requirements WHERE '
+                'id=NEW.requirement_id AND transaction_id=pg_current_xact_id();\n'
+                ' IF NOT FOUND OR '
+                '(r.aggregate_type,r.aggregate_id,r.revision,r.kind,r.body,r.occurred_at,r.observed_at,r.recorded_at,r.provenance)\n'
+                ' IS DISTINCT FROM '
+                '(NEW.aggregate_type,NEW.aggregate_id,NEW.revision,NEW.kind,NEW.body,NEW.occurred_at,NEW.observed_at,NEW.recorded_at,NEW.provenance) '
+                'THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox requires exact current transaction "
+                "projection'; END IF;\n"
+                ' IF (NEW.revision=1) IS DISTINCT FROM (NEW.predecessor_id IS '
+                "NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox predecessor inconsistent'; END "
+                'IF;\n'
+                ' IF NEW.revision>1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM '
+                'public.public_pending_events e WHERE '
+                'e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id\n'
+                '   AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+                'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision-1)\n'
+                '  AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_archive_coverage e '
+                'WHERE e.event_id=NEW.predecessor_id\n'
+                '   AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+                'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision-1) '
+                'THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox predecessor unavailable'; END IF;\n"
+                " envelope:=convert_from(NEW.canonical_event,'UTF8')::jsonb;\n"
+                " IF envelope->>'event_id'<>NEW.event_id::text OR "
+                "envelope->>'aggregate_type'<>NEW.aggregate_type\n"
+                " OR envelope->>'aggregate_id'<>NEW.aggregate_id OR "
+                "(envelope->>'revision')::bigint<>NEW.revision\n"
+                " OR envelope->>'predecessor_id' IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "NEW.predecessor_id::text OR envelope->>'kind'<>NEW.kind\n"
+                " OR (envelope->>'observed_at')::timestamptz IS DISTINCT FROM "
+                "NEW.observed_at OR (envelope->>'recorded_at')::timestamptz IS "
+                "DISTINCT FROM NEW.recorded_at OR envelope->>'provenance' IS "
+                "DISTINCT FROM NEW.provenance OR envelope->'body'<>NEW.body OR "
+                "(envelope->>'occurred_at')::timestamptz<>NEW.occurred_at THEN\n"
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'outbox canonical envelope differs'; END IF;\n"
+                ' SELECT count(*),lifecycle_private.archive_budget_bytes() INTO '
+                'usage_count,usage_bytes FROM public.public_pending_events;\n'
+                " critical:=NEW.kind IN ('closed','reopened');\n"
+                ' IF usage_count+1>(CASE WHEN critical THEN 100000 ELSE 87500 '
+                'END)\n'
+                ' OR '
+                'usage_bytes+lifecycle_private.archive_row_charge(NEW.body,NEW.canonical_event,2048)+lifecycle_private.archive_processing_charge(NEW.canonical_event)>(CASE '
+                'WHEN critical THEN 134217728 ELSE 117440512 END) THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'public outbox budget exhausted'; END IF;\n"
+                ' RETURN NEW;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',
+                'proconfig': [
+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'validate_public_pair',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION '
+                'lifecycle_private.validate_public_pair()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                ' IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.public_outbox e WHERE '
+                'e.requirement_id=NEW.id\n'
+                '  AND e.aggregate_type=NEW.aggregate_type AND '
+                'e.aggregate_id=NEW.aggregate_id AND e.revision=NEW.revision\n'
+                '  AND e.kind=NEW.kind AND e.body=NEW.body AND '
+                'e.occurred_at=NEW.occurred_at AND e.observed_at IS NOT DISTINCT '
+                'FROM NEW.observed_at AND e.recorded_at=NEW.recorded_at AND '
+                'e.provenance=NEW.provenance) THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'public change requires exact transactional "
+                "outbox event';\n"
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                ' RETURN NULL;\n'
+                'END $function$\n',
+                'proconfig': [
+                    'search_path=pg_catalog',
+                ],
+                'prosecdef': False,
+                'proacl': '{postgres=X/postgres}',
+                'owner': 'postgres',
+            },
+            {
+                'nspname': 'lifecycle_private',
+                'proname': 'validate_write',
+                'arguments': '',
+                'definition': 'CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lifecycle_private.validate_write()\n'
+                ' RETURNS trigger\n'
+                ' LANGUAGE plpgsql\n'
+                ' SECURITY DEFINER\n'
+                " SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'\n"
+                'AS $function$\n'
+                'DECLARE c public.lifecycle_claims; r '
+                'public.capacity_reservations; actor name;\n'
+                'BEGIN\n'
+                ' -- PostgreSQL lets any caller consume a deferred constraint '
+                'early. Only the\n'
+                ' -- actual top-level, standalone transaction boundary may run '
+                'this AFTER check.\n'
+                ' -- current_query() is server-provided, not a GUC. Fail closed '
+                'for comments,\n'
+                ' -- multi-statements, SET CONSTRAINTS, implicit/autocommit and '
+                'PREPARE TRANSACTION.\n'
+                ' -- Supported writers explicitly finish with COMMIT/END '
+                '[WORK|TRANSACTION].\n'
+                " IF TG_WHEN='AFTER' AND COALESCE(current_query(),'') !~* "
+                "'^[[:space:]]*(COMMIT|END)([[:space:]]+(WORK|TRANSACTION))?[[:space:]]*;?[[:space:]]*$' "
+                'THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle receipts require standalone COMMIT "
+                "or END validation';\n"
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                " -- role is PostgreSQL's actual SET ROLE state, not a "
+                'caller-supplied identity GUC.\n'
+                " actor:=CASE WHEN current_setting('role')='none' THEN "
+                "session_user ELSE current_setting('role') END;\n"
+                " IF TG_WHEN='BEFORE' AND (NEW.invoking_role<>actor OR "
+                'NEW.subject_id IS DISTINCT FROM public.app_user_id()\n'
+                ' OR NEW.backend_pid<>pg_backend_pid() OR '
+                'NEW.transaction_id<>pg_current_xact_id()) THEN\n'
+                "  RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid lifecycle invoking identity';\n"
+                ' END IF;\n'
+                ' IF NEW.bytes>0 AND pg_database_size(current_database())+(SELECT '
+                'COALESCE(sum(bytes),0) FROM public.capacity_reservations WHERE '
+                "state='held')>6291456000 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'physical capacity "
+                "budget exceeded'; END IF;\n"
+                " IF NEW.total_rows>500 THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'lifecycle admission "
+                "chunk exceeds 500 rows'; END IF;\n"
+                ' IF NEW.bytes>0 AND NEW.reservation_id IS NULL THEN RAISE '
+                "EXCEPTION 'growth_without_reservation'; END IF;\n"
+                ' IF NEW.reservation_id IS NOT NULL THEN\n'
+                '  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.capacity_reservations WHERE '

diff --git a/.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-07-job-lifecycle-reconstruction/final-fix1-evidence/browser/run.cjs b/.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-07-job-lifecycle-reconstruction/final-fix1-evidence/browser/run.cjs

index 0000000..8c17736

+++ b/.superpowers/sdd/2026-10-07-job-lifecycle-reconstruction/final-fix1-evidence/browser/run.cjs
@@ -0,0 +1,28 @@
+const path=require('node:path'),fs=require('node:fs'),http=require('node:http');
+const root=process.cwd(),dir=__dirname;
+const esbuild=require(path.join(root,'dashboard/node_modules/esbuild'));
+const {chromium,expect}=require(path.join(root,'dashboard/node_modules/@playwright/test'));
+(async()=>{
+ const bundle=await esbuild.build({entryPoints:[path.join(dir,'entry.tsx')],bundle:true,write:false,jsx:'automatic',platform:'browser',define:{'process.env.NODE_ENV':'"development"'},tsconfig:path.join(root,'dashboard/tsconfig.json'),nodePaths:[path.join(root,'dashboard/node_modules')]});
+ const server=http.createServer((req,res)=>{if(req.url==='/entry.js'){res.setHeader('Content-Type','application/javascript');res.end(bundle.outputFiles[0].text);}else{res.end('<html><body><div id="root"></div><script src="/entry.js"></script></body></html>')}});
+ await new Promise(resolve=>server.listen(0,'127.0.0.1',resolve));
+ let browser;const errors=[],blocked=[],assertions=[];
+ try {
+  const base='http://127.0.0.1:'+server.address().port;
+  browser=await chromium.launch({executablePath:'/usr/bin/chromium',headless:true,args:['--no-sandbox']});
+  const page=await browser.newPage();page.on('pageerror',e=>errors.push(e.message));
+  await page.route('**/*',route=>{if(new URL(route.request().url()).origin!==base){blocked.push(route.request().url());return route.abort();}return route.continue();});
+  for(const [name,width,height] of [['desktop',1280,800],['mobile',390,844]]){
+   await page.setViewportSize({width,height});await page.goto(base);
+   await expect(page.getByText('10',{exact:true})).toHaveCount(2);
+   await expect(page.getByText(/Applied totals include retained history/)).toBeVisible();
+   await expect(page.getByText(/of approved/)).toHaveCount(0);
+   await expect(page.getByRole('button',{name:/Applied\./})).toBeVisible();
+   assertions.push(name+': actual FunnelSection shows lifetime applied=10, approved=2, no cross-cohort percentage, retained-history caption');
+   await page.screenshot({path:path.join(dir,name+'.png'),fullPage:true});
+  }
+  if(errors.length||blocked.length)throw Error(JSON.stringify({errors,blocked}));
+  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir,'result.json'),JSON.stringify({browser:browser.version(),target:'owned random loopback',boundary:'actual FunnelSection; static fixture metrics; no server/auth/provider',assertions,errors,blocked},null,2));
+  console.log('PASS '+assertions.length+' viewports, eight assertions; Chromium '+browser.version());
+ }finally{if(browser)await browser.close();await new Promise(resolve=>server.close(resolve));}
+})().catch(e=>{console.error(e);process.exitCode=1});

diff --git a/job_discovery/lifecycle/followup.py b/job_discovery/lifecycle/followup.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..a93d8ef
--- /dev/null
+++ b/job_discovery/lifecycle/followup.py
@@ -0,0 +1,76 @@
+"""Finite suspicious-empty diagnostics using stored public coordinates only."""
+import logging
+from contextlib import contextmanager
+from time import monotonic
+
+from .reconcile import _write
+
+log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+@contextmanager
+def _change(conn, source_id, claim, operational):
+    if operational:
+        from .operational import _receipt
+        _receipt(conn, source_id, claim)
+        yield
+    else:
+        with _write(conn, claim, "source_accounts"):
+            yield
+
+
+def schedule(conn, source_id, claim, *, operational=False):
+    with _change(conn, source_id, claim, operational):
+        conn.execute("""UPDATE source_accounts SET followup_due_at=clock_timestamp(),followup_status='pending'
+          WHERE id=%s AND suspicious_empty_streak>=2 AND followup_due_at IS NULL
+          AND (last_followup_at IS NULL OR last_followup_at<=clock_timestamp()-interval '24 hours')""", (source_id,))
+
+
+def run(conn, source, claim, budget, *, operational=False):
+    """Consume at most three remaining requests and the SAME board time budget.
+
+    Persist the attempt before HTTP: interrupted/retried turns do not append
+    queue rows or repeat a sample inside 24 hours. Live/unknown responses provide
+    migration diagnostics; neither supplies inferred absence or mass closure.
+    """
+    from .demand import fetch_payload
+    from .claims import renew_claim
+    from job_discovery.adapters.completeness import source_budget
+
+    if budget is None or budget[1] <= 0 or monotonic() >= budget[0]:
+        return
+    due = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM source_accounts WHERE id=%s AND followup_due_at<=clock_timestamp()", (source["id"],)).fetchone()
+    if not due:
+        conn.commit()
+        return
+    rows = conn.execute("""SELECT l.external_id FROM source_listings l JOIN jobs j ON j.id=l.job_id
+      WHERE l.source_account_id=%s AND j.closed_at IS NULL ORDER BY l.external_id LIMIT %s""",
+      (source["id"],min(3,budget[1]))).fetchall()
+    with _change(conn, source["id"], claim, operational):
+        conn.execute("""UPDATE source_accounts SET followup_due_at=NULL,last_followup_at=clock_timestamp(),
+          followup_status='running' WHERE id=%s""", (source["id"],))
+    conn.commit()
+    log.warning("source %s action needed: repeated suspicious empty; migration review; representative exact checks=%s",
+                source["id"],len(rows))
+    live = 0
+    def pulse():
+        if operational:
+            from .operational import _receipt
+            _receipt(conn,source["id"],claim)
+        else:
+            renew_claim(conn,claim)
+        conn.commit()
+    with source_budget(max(0,budget[0]-monotonic()), min(3,budget[1]), pulse):
+        for row in rows:
+            if monotonic() >= budget[0]:
+                break
+            try:
+                payload = fetch_payload({"ats":source["ats"],"public_board_ref":source["public_board_ref"],"external_id":row["external_id"]})
+                live += payload is not None
+            except Exception:
+                # HTTP failure, missing URL, or malformed input is unknown.
+                pass
+    with _change(conn, source["id"], claim, operational):
+        conn.execute("UPDATE source_accounts SET followup_status='migration_review' WHERE id=%s", (source["id"],))
+    conn.commit()
+    log.warning("source %s migration review remains required: representative live=%s; no absence inferred",source["id"],live)
